Your website○ NOT CONNECTED

Its visits and clicks, counted here the moment it is linked.

Will feed → Pulse · Trend

Connect in the Smart Factory

Its clicks land in the pulse, the trend and Naya’s read. When you are ready, your website is linked to this world once — in the Smart Factory. From that moment its visits and clicks are simply more rows in the same tables these blocks already read, so this front fills deeper on its own. Until then, this card stays exactly as honest as it looks: an invitation, not a number.

📣
Your social feeds○ NOT CONNECTED

Its posts and reactions, woven into your world’s story.

Will feed → Pulse · Faces

Its posts and reactions join your world’s story. Each feed is connected with its own sign-in, once, and only with your permission. Its activity then appears beside your native posts and messages — one world, one front. Nothing is pulled in, estimated or back-filled before that moment; a source that is not connected shows no numbers at all.

🤖
Your AIs○ NOT CONNECTED

Its work — sessions, creations, results — among your faces.

Will feed → Faces · Trend

Its work — sessions, creations, results — shows up here. An AI connects the way a person joins: it gets its own identity in your world, and what it does is written into the same activity these blocks read. You will see its face among your faces and its work in your trend. Until one is connected, this card promises the shape — and shows no invented activity.

📅
Booking○ NOT CONNECTED

Bookable hours and appointments, counted here the moment booking is switched on.

Will feed → Pulse · Faces

Open your booking door

Your booking engine is live — people book your real hours at nayanet.app/book, and every appointment is written into the same activity these blocks read, counted here beside everything else. Calendar sync is not connected yet: until it is, bookings live in NayaNET only — this card says so plainly rather than pretending otherwise.

💳
Payments○ NOT CONNECTED

Money from your pages, counted here the moment payments are switched on.

Will feed → Pulse · Faces

Open your payment door

A payment link on your page takes the money through Stripe — connected with its own sign-in, once, and only with your permission. Every payment is written into the same activity these blocks read: this front says “you made X from Y”, each payment is filed on the person who paid, and a payment that fails becomes a kind drafted recovery message in your Growth room — never a silent loss. Until payments are connected, this card shows no numbers at all.

✦ My Smart Link

A Smart Link is your own short NayaNET address — nayanet.app/your-name — that sends people to any link you choose and counts every click on the way through. Paste any link you want tracked — a video, a product page, your ambassador link — claim a name, then share the short address everywhere. Every click is counted, and when someone who arrived through it joins NayaNET, that join is credited to your link too. You choose where it sends people, and NayaNET never changes that. Pick your name carefully — a claimed name can’t be renamed later.

One short address for everything you share — and every click on it, counted. Paste the link you share today, pick the name you want instead, and your short link is live — with every click on it counted.

Ambassador payouts land every Wednesday, after the trial period — no holdbacks.

Reading your Smart Links…
Your short address will be nayanet.app/ + the name you pick. Start typing — we’ll tell you right away if it’s free.
